'''Oudon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He and [[Hendrick]] both worked at a [[Celestial Industries factory|factory]] owned by [[Celestial Industries]] in the [[Labor Valley]] prior to the [[Battle of Corellia]], at which [[Time/Legends|time]] Oudon led a resistance cell against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] occupation. [[Havoc Squad]] linked up Oudon's cell with Hendrick's and [[Sherro]]'s, and the group set up an ambush in the Celestial Industries factory that wiped out a large number of Imperials.<ref name="TOR" />
